map.圆管层流体积流量。: Volume flow rate for laminar flow in a circular pipe.
map.Q = πΔP r⁴/(8μL)。 流量对半径极敏感（四次方）。: Q = πΔP r⁴/(8μL). The flow is extremely sensitive to the radius, to the fourth power.
map.流量对半径极敏感（四次方）。: The flow is extremely sensitive to the radius, to the fourth power.
map.算圆管层流流量: Compute the laminar flow rate in a circular pipe
map.Q = pi*Δp*R^4/(8*mu*L)。例：R=1 mm、L=1 m、Δp: Q = pi*Δp*R^4/(8*mu*L). Example: with R=1 mm, L=1 m, Δp=1000 Pa and water mu=1e-3, Q=pi*1000*1e-12/(8e-3)=3.93e-7 m³/s.
map.Q 正比 R^4，半径微增流量大增。: Q is proportional to R^4, so even a small increase in radius greatly increases the flow.
map.仅 Re<~2300 层流成立，否则用湍流公式。: It holds only while Re stays below about 2300; beyond that, use turbulent flow formulas.
map.泊肃叶层流流量（本页代码口径）：Q=π×ΔP×r⁴÷(8×μ×L)（m³/s，Δ: Poiseuille laminar flow (as implemented here): Q=π×ΔP×r⁴÷(8×μ×L) (m³/s, ΔP pressure difference in Pa, r tube radius in m, μ viscosity in Pa·s, L tube length in m); linked value: Q (mL/s)=Q×10⁶. Validation: blank or invalid input in any of the four fields prompts a message and stops. Criteria: no fixed grading; Q is proportional to the fourth power of the diameter (doubling the radius raises flow 16-fold) and inversely proportional to viscosity and length, and the formula applies only to laminar (low Reynolds number) conditions.
